findings.what: The pre-approval WhatIf job on a hosted agent uses the same subscription-scope ARM service connection as Deploy, so prod ARM access is exercised with no approval gate.
findings.why: API8 hardening, least privilege. The job needs only what-if (read) rights. Residual risk is limited: the pipeline triggers only on main with pr: none, and David merges. A bad merge to main could still use the prod ARM connection without the policies-prod approval. Suggested: a Reader-plus-what-if connection for this job, or service-connection checks (branch control, approval). Not blocking for an evidence-only pipeline that is never run.

notes: Out items recorded as n/a: API1 (no auth or tenancy; the reference is the only key), API2 (auth out of scope), API5 (no roles), API7 (no outbound URL fetching; this diff touches only infrastructure and docs, no src/), API10 (no upstream APIs).

Round scope: the diff since A2.3 splits the stage template into a WhatIf job and an approval-gated Deploy job, and changes check-pipeline.py. The packet diff also carries the earlier F5 infrastructure and docs/qa changes, which are unchanged since A2.3.

New unapproved job, what it introduces: it is a hosted ubuntu-latest agent with no environment. It runs az deployment sub what-if with --name, which creates no deployment and changes no resources. It downloads the drop artifact built in the same run, so what the approver reviews is the artifact Deploy later applies (same-run integrity). The pipeline triggers only on main with pr: none, so no fork or PR code reaches the job, and the YAML and Bicep it executes are already merged to main.

The WhatIf job links the policies-<env> variable group before approval. It holds only sqlAdminGroupObjectId, an Entra group object id, which is not a secret. If secrets are later added to that group, move them out of the unapproved job's reach. Worth recording as a P2 note.

No secrets in the diff: Bicep has no @secure parameters and SQL is Entra-only with no password. check-pipeline.py scans for secret-looking literals, and the grep of infrastructure/ found none. The SQL steps still use the separate sqlServiceConnection, and Deploy stays on the self-hosted VNet pool. what-if output in logs carries resource configuration only (no personal data).

SQL extras: no FromSqlRaw or ExecuteSqlRaw in the diff, and no .cs changes, so the money, logging and package checks are unchanged. gate.vulnerable (head c2af74d) reports 8 projects, none vulnerable. The Deploy job's inline sqlcmd interpolates $(appName) from Bicep outputs, which is pipeline-controlled and not user input.
API3, API4, API6 and API9 are unaffected by this diff (no src/ changes) and are recorded as met by the unchanged A2.3 baseline. API8 is met: no committed secrets or connection strings.
